after_development.input: same frozen r1 manifest and package only; independent of dev; re-hash every source and compare with the r0 manifest and the r1 manifest; re-derive Routed SWNS/TNS/hold/period/violation counts, resource delta and CDC from the same reports; verify bit/CWC/BID binding and that cw/compiled.bit equals a1_board.bit; re-parse the same COM8 capture (v3 ver/len/XOR, first/last counter deltas) and re-run the 44 B header + stream CRC + zlib decode; confirm the download log/BID and the single-download count; re-check the r0 G1 evidence remains the bound input; treat the optional R1/3-frame extras as evidence-only; no TD rerun, no download, no Flash

acceptance.G2-r1: Routed zero violations, SWNS >= +0.05 ns, STNS 0, HWNS >= 0, HTNS 0, period 0; resources vs b9 within 5% and ERAM not increased; no new unexplained CDC/comb loop; 1 bitgen + 1 CWC; bit byte-identical to cw/compiled.bit; bit/CWC/BID hashes bound in the r1 manifest
acceptance.G3-r1: download-first-then-listen order; >=2 valid v3 packets; first-to-last deltas of raw_pub, enc_frames and exported all >0; >=1 frame with A5 5A header, valid ver/len, stream_len match, stream CRC OK and zlib decode to 1920x1080/2,592,000 B; status packets only between frames
acceptance.partial: state packets present but any delta is 0 or the frame does not decode -> WARN, keep the candidate and evidence, document the blocker, no second download
acceptance.G4-r1: result-r1.md + lessons-r1.md (if any) + r1 manifest/hashes + independent integrated tester report bound to the same manifest; parent T10 stays blocked/not done

scope_limits: Same T10, same run, same task_id; r1 is a candidate rebuild plus one board round, not a new design round. No RTL/param/SDC/pin/port changes; no comment-only edits (they would break the hash binding); the camera top's stale '// T10.b10 R1:' comments stay as-is and are documented as historical. Do not change the 44 B frame header, stream CRC, zlib, the no-insertion rule inside frames, UART divider, crop geometry, MIPI or display path. Do not delete any old directory; archive by copy/rename only. No new run, no new parent ID, no bulk delete, no overwrite of b9 evidence.

execution_limits.retry: r1 TD and download are single-shot: no first-attempt-plus-one retry. Two consecutive cycles without new evidence -> blocked. A tool/environment-only failure may be retried only with written planner authorisation and without consuming an extra synth/route/download.

board_authorization: User authorised exactly one SRAM download in r1 (cumulative <=2 of the existing board budget) plus one 180 s COM8 capture. Order: close COM8 -> download over JTAG/SRAM -> release FTDI/hwserver -> open COM8 -> capture. No Flash, no board swap, no rewiring/power/camera changes. Run tools/td/open_td.ps1 before TD; X: is forbidden. The actual cumulative count must be written into result-r1.md.
